scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) For Handicraft Artisans: Assistance For Capital Investment For The Handloom And Handicrafts Artisans Of The U.T. Requiring Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Machinery Or Raw Materials
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Interested in purchasing machinery or raw materials for business development
Must have Handloom or Handicraft skills and demonstrate products to the evaluation committee
benefits_summary: Up to ₹2,00,000 subsidy (50% of investment) for machinery purchase and working‑capital loan, with an additional 10% subsidy for SC/ST/Women/Differently‑abled applicants.
